description: Market-neutral: for every pair of coins whose daily returns moved closely together before the split, short the one that has run ahead and buy the one that has lagged when their price ratio is unusually stretched, and close when it returns to normal. Futures costs on both legs.
name: Pairs trading (statistical arbitrage)
notes: Pairs with a correlation of at least 0.75 before the split: BTC/ETH, BTC/LTC, ETH/LTC, XRP/XLM, LTC/BCH
Pairs with a correlation of at least 0.85 before the split: none
selection: Selected: Sharpe of at least 1 and at least 15% a year before 2024-07-01. Survived: Sharpe of at least 0.5 and a profit from then on.
